sentences.text: The offences alleged against the petitioners are under Section 498A, 406 r/w 34 of IPC.

2. The prosecution case is that the 1st accused being the husband of the defacto complainant and the other accused being his relatives subjected her to cruelty both physically and mentally on the ground of dowry, misappropriated her gold, and thereby they are alleged to have committed the aforesaid offences.

Jamsheed vs State Of Kerala on 27 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/189256096/
2
3. According to the petitioners, even if the entire allegations levelled against the petitioners are believed as such, the same does not constitute the offences as alleged.
Therefore, she prayed for quashing all further proceedings against the petitioner.
4. The petition was strongly opposed by the learned counsel for the 3 rd respondent/defacto complainant as well as by the learned Public Prosecutor.

5. On a perusal of the FI statement, it can be seen that though several allegations are levelled against the accused persons in general, there is no specific allegation with material particulars like date, so as to constitute the offence punishable under Section 498 A of IPC.
Therefore, there is no meaning 2026:KER:27707 in continuing the proceedings against the petitioners as the same will only be an abuse of the process of the court.
6. Therefore, this Crl.M.C. is allowed.
All further proceedings against the petitioners in CC.
No.280/2021 pending before the Judicial First Class Magistrate, Nilambur, arising out of Crime No.68/2021 of Nilambur Police Station, Malappuram, is quashed.

Sd/-
C. PRATHEEP KUMAR, JUDGE sou.
2026
